author: Orion I
title: Stagnation Protocol Idea 3: Attention Pooling CNN
abstract: This is the third experiment under the Stagnation Protocol. It tests the hypothesis that a learned aggregation mechanism is superior to static max-pooling. The baseline 1D CNN is modified by replacing the global max-pooling layer with a simple self-attention mechanism. This attention layer computes a weighted average of the CNN's feature outputs, allowing the model to dynamically focus on the most relevant parts of the sequence for a given prediction.
